page.layout: One page of text in a single column; a decorative ornamental header above the title; a large historiated woodcut initial at the left of the first paragraph; a signature mark at the foot. No marginal notes. A blue library stamp at lower right is ignored.

main_text.head: Augustanus, ALBERTO ASTETEN, Georgij V. C. F. adolescenti optime indolis atque spei, S. P. D.
main_text.p: Vos ad te, ALBERTE carissime, mitto Libellos, eos Græcos ex vetustissimis membranis, rarissimo, mihiq; alias nunquam uiso literarum genere coscriptis, liberali permissu Illustrissimi optimiq; PRINCIPIS ac Domini mei, in cuius bibliotheca is codex abs me erat repertus, transcriptos, superiore anno, cum otiosus Augustæ essem, in Latinum sermonem translui. De quibus edendis in lucem cum cogitarem, simul venit mihi in mentem M. Antonini de vita sua librorum, quos (quanquam λογὰς potiùs operis, quàm ipsum opus, ipsosq; integros libros esse iudico) ante annos fere nouem à me Latinos factos ad patrem tuum, virum omni vera laude cumulatissimum, officij causa emiseram. page.notes: The Greek words in the text ("λογὰς") are a doubtful reading. The ornamental header and woodcut initial are decorative. The stamp at lower right is a library mark and is not transcribed. Catchword "in" is at the foot of the text block and is treated as a catchword in the text paragraph above.
